questions.question: Which theory describes the view that different religions reveal different yet complementary truths about the divine?
questions.explanation: Pluralism in theology refers to the perspective that different religious traditions contribute in their own way to the perception of the divine, without elevating one religion as absolute truth over the others. This theory promotes interreligious dialogue and understanding between different faith communities.

Which of these sea fish is particularly rich in iodine and is often recommended for a diet high in iodine?
questions.explanation: Cod is known for its high iodine content and is often recommended in the diet to prevent iodine deficiency. Sea fish in general are a good source of iodine, which is important for thyroid function.

questions.question: Which of the following canals connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean and has played a crucial role in international trade?
questions.explanation: The Panama Canal, opened in 1914, allows for a direct shipping connection between the Atlantic and Pacific, avoiding long detours around South America. It has significant impacts on global trade and shipping efficiency.

questions.question: Which work from the Middle Ages is considered a significant medical compendium and influenced European medicine until the 16th century?
questions.explanation: The 'Canon medicinae', written by Avicenna (Ibn Sina) in the 11th century, was a comprehensive medical textbook used as a standard work in many European universities. It combined ancient knowledge with personal observations and was highly influential until the Renaissance.

questions.question: Which of the following artists is a prominent figure of Neo-Expressionism, contributing to a revival of emotional expression in painting during the 1980s?
questions.explanation: Anselm Kiefer is known for his large-scale works that often deal with historical and mythological themes, characteristic of Neo-Expressionism. This movement aimed for a return to emotional and artisanal approaches in art, in contrast to the conceptual practices of previous decades.

questions.question: What adaptation allows the polar bear to survive in extremely cold climates while successfully hunting seals?
choices: A: The ability to walk on ice without sinking.
B: Enhanced hearing to locate prey.
C: Special eye structure for better vision in darkness.
D: Thick layer of fat under the skin for insulation.
questions.explanation: Polar bears have a thick layer of fat under their skin that serves as insulation, protecting them from the extreme cold of the Arctic. This adaptation is crucial for their survival as well as their hunting strategies for seals on the ice.

Which of the following national teams has won the Rugby World Cup most frequently?
questions.explanation: New Zealand, known as the All Blacks, has won the Rugby World Cup a total of three times (1987, 2011, 2015) and is considered one of the most dominant teams in rugby history. South Africa and Australia have also won two titles each, while England has won one title.

questions.question: What is the primary aim of language policy in relation to language purity?
choices: A: To promote the use of indigenous terms over loanwords
B: To establish a universal language for all cultures
C: To eliminate all foreign influences from literature
D: To create new words by blending existing ones
questions.explanation: Language policy focuses on preserving the integrity of a language by encouraging the use of native terms instead of foreign imports. This approach often leads to debates about the appropriateness of loanwords in everyday language. The aim is to maintain linguistic identity and cultural heritage.

questions.question: Which protocol is commonly used for email transmission?
questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is the standard protocol for sending emails over the Internet. IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol), on the other hand, is used to retrieve emails from the server. FTP (File Transfer Protocol) is for file transfer, while HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is responsible for accessing web pages.

questions.question: What is a key difference between Altcoins and Bitcoin?
choices: A: Altcoins are always cheaper than Bitcoin.
B: Bitcoin is the first and most well-known cryptocurrency, while Altcoins are all other cryptocurrencies.
C: Bitcoin uses the Proof-of-Stake protocol, while Altcoins always use Proof-of-Work.
D: Altcoins cannot be traded on exchanges.

questions.question: Which of the following types of cancer is often associated with increased exposure to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Skin cancer, particularly Malignant Melanoma, is often associated with UV radiation from sunlight. Excessive sun exposure can increase the risk of developing this type of cancer. It is important to protect oneself from UV radiation to prevent skin cancer.
